description: Minimal, standalone confirmation that tools/qclsrc/txmigr.clp's redesigned DCLF (against the IBM-supplied model outfiles QSYS/QADSPDBR and QSYS/QADSPOBJ, instead of this program's own QTEMP/TXMDBR and QTEMP/TXMPGM) actually lets CRTCLPGM succeed in a completely fresh job - no priming steps of any kind, unlike verify/part05-txmigr-to2b's own CPTXMIGRRW (which confirmed the OLD design genuinely failed to compile without priming). This connection only recompiles TXMIGR (REPLACE(*YES) over whatever part05-txmigr-to2b already left in &LIB) - it does not run it, and does not touch &LIB2 at all.
